comment: HANDOFF-002 section 2-1: the native HEIC decoding libraries of the product (ADR-002 B1), built from the upstream sources named here by scripts/build-native.ps1 - decoding only: no HEVC encoder (x265, kvazaar) and no other codec is compiled in, plugin loading is off. The built files go to native/win-x64 (not in Git); their bytes are pinned below and scripts/build-native.ps1 refuses a build that differs. To change a version or an option: edit this file, run scripts/build-native.ps1 -UpdatePins, run every test including scripts/golden-update.ps1 -Check, and update THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt in the same commit. Both libraries are LGPL: each stays a separate DLL so that it can be replaced by another build with the same interface.

libraries.name: libde265
libraries.patchesConfirmed: Kev, 2026-10-11: the patched build is the product's build (option A of the HANDOFF-002 report, PROJECT_STATUS.md section 8.4). The other options were the unpatched library (sample syn-13 and every picture stored as one NAL unit above 16 MiB cannot be converted) and libde265 1.0.19 (crashes, lacks published security fixes). A library that is patched without this entry needs a top-level 'pendingDecision' text instead, which makes scripts/package.ps1 refuse to package.
libraries.patchesNote: One changed line: the default of libde265's own limit for the size of a single NAL unit goes from 16 MiB to 256 MiB. libde265 1.1.0 introduced the limit; libheif 1.23.6 hands its image-size limit to libde265 but has no setting for this one, so a picture stored as one NAL unit above 16 MiB (sample syn-13: 48 MP in a single NAL of 17,276,919 bytes) is refused with 'NAL unit size exceeds security limit'. Every other limit of both libraries stays as upstream.
libraries.optionsNote: ENABLE_DECODER / ENABLE_ENCODER switch the command-line tools dec265 / enc265 (and, for the encoder, its code inside the library); the HEVC decoder itself is always part of the library.

libraries.name: libheif
libraries.optionsNote: Everything that is not the built-in libde265 HEVC decoder is switched off. With MSVC the library is built as heif.dll; scripts/build-native.ps1 stores it as libheif.dll, the name LibHeifSharp imports (see builtAs below).

build.runtime: dynamic C runtime (/MD); the Visual C++ runtime files travel with the package (store/vc-runtime.json)
build.reproducibility: /Brepro for the compiler and the linker: no time stamps in the files
build.toolchain: MSVC toolset 14.51.36231 (cl 19.51.36257), Windows SDK 10.0.28000.0, CMake 4.3.1-msvc1, Ninja 1.13.2
